newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Frances upgrades Siderca.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Frances upgrades Siderca.

text.p: -- Banco Frances upgraded Argentine steelmaker Siderca to strong buy from buy.
-- Analyst Gustavo Pascual said the company's results (1st half net $86.9 million vs $9.1 million) were much better than expected by most analysts and the bank itslef.
-- Strong oil prices may prompt higher prices for Siderca's steel tubes for oil industry.
-- "We took also into consideration strong earnings at Siderca's related companies: Argentina's Siderar, Tubos de Acero de Mexico SA (TAMSA) and Italy's Dalmine.
-- "Siderca being basically an export oriented company means it is not exposed to domestic market ups and downs," Pascual said.
